results.headline: Trading Ahead of Full Year 2026 Expectations
results.key_quote: adjusted operating profit and EPS for the Group are expected to be ahead of Company compiled analysts' consensus for 2026
results.summary: Rosebank reports trading ahead of full year 2026 expectations with positive performance across all three businesses. Adjusted operating profit and EPS are expected to exceed analysts' consensus. ECI achieved 16.8% adjusted operating margin (targeting 18%), CPM is implementing restructuring with new management in place, and MW Components has increased adjusted operating margin by six percentage points with expectations to nearly achieve the 21-22% target. All three acquisitions are delivering margin expansion opportunities ahead of initial expectations.
metrics_ahead: Adjusted operating profit ahead of analysts' consensus
ECI adjusted operating margin at 16.8% (progressing toward 18% target)
ECI revenue 3% higher year-on-year (6% adjusting for low-margin exits)
ECI E&I division revenue growth of 14%
MW Components adjusted operating margin increased by six percentage points year-on-year

results.headline: STATEMENT RE INSMED INCORPORATED
results.key_quote: The loan is expected to be prepaid upon the closing of the Transaction. Pursuant to the senior secured loan agreement, in connection with the Transaction and the repayment of outstanding principal, the Company is expected to receive a make-whole payment for the remainder of the three-year make-whole period, a prepayment premium of 3%, along with an exit consideration of 2%.
results.summary: BioPharma Credit PLC announced details regarding the anticipated prepayment of its US$218.7 million senior secured loan to Insmed upon Sanofi's acquisition of Insmed (US$41.0 billion equity value, expected to close H1 2027). The announcement provides illustrative calculations showing expected prepayment fees and exit consideration of approximately US$18.1 million if closed on 30 June 2027, but contains no comparison to market expectations, guidance, or forecasts. This is a corporate update regarding contractual terms of an existing investment.

results.headline: Whistlejacket Lithium Project Update
results.key_quote: WSTL0022 returned 38.13 meters at 1.34% Li₂O, including 23.39 meters at 1.62% Li₂O, and intersected the mineralized pegmatite up-dip of WSTL0020. These results, which include the longest and highest-grade lithium-mineralized interval in the program to date, add to our understanding of the geometry and grade distribution of the mineralized body at Whistlejacket.
results.summary: Bradda Head announced assay results from drillhole WSTL0022 at the Whistlejacket Lithium Project. The company reported the longest and highest-grade lithium-mineralized interval in their drilling program to date, with 38.13m at 1.34% Li₂O including 23.39m at 1.62% Li₂O. However, this is an exploration-stage project update with no stated comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or guidance. The results are presented as absolute drilling data without reference to what was expected by the board, market, or analysts. No guidance upgrade, maintenance, or revision is mentioned.

results.headline: Corporate update
results.key_quote: Celsius continues to target completion of the divestment before the end of the Calendar Year
results.summary: This is a corporate update covering pending asset divestment, legal disputes, and regulatory matters. The company provides operational/transactional updates (Opuwo Project divestment targeting year-end completion with conditional pre-approvals received, disputes with Equinaire and Sodor) but contains no comparison of financial results or operational performance against expectations, forecasts, or guidance. No financial results are reported and no performance metrics are benchmarked against market or board expectations.

results.headline: 9M 2026 Results
results.key_quote: Revenues increased 36% year-on-year to EGP 7.9 billion, supported by an 18% increase in tests performed and a 15% rise in average revenue per test. Net profit rose 52% year-on-year to EGP 1.5 billion.
results.summary: IDH reported strong year-on-year growth across all key metrics in 9M 2026: revenue +36%, gross profit +39%, EBITDA +35%, and net profit +52%. The company achieved margin expansion with gross profit margin at 44.4% (up 100bps) and net profit margin at 18.6% (up 190bps). Performance was driven by network expansion (176 new branches), pricing optimization, increased test volumes (+18%), and higher revenue per test (+15%). However, no forward-looking guidance or comparison to market/analyst expectations was provided in the announcement, so the results cannot be classified against expectations.

results.headline: AGM Statement
results.key_quote: Trading remains in line with expectations for the year ending 30 June 2027
results.summary: Abingdon Health reports that Q2 FY27 has begun well with October revenues exceeding £1.0 million and expects Q2 revenues to be significantly improved compared to Q1 FY27. However, the company explicitly states that trading remains 'in line with expectations' for the full year ending 30 June 2027. The improvement in Q2 reflects the recommencement of customer programmes that experienced delays in Q1 due to reagent availability and specification updates. While Q2 performance relative to Q1 is positive, the company provides no indication of beating full-year expectations.

results.headline: AGM Statement and Trading Update
results.key_quote: The Board remains confident in the Group's ability to deliver full year 2027 revenue, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPS in line with market expectations.
results.summary: CVS Group reported a trading update for the four-month period to 31 October 2026 showing revenue growth of 6.2% and adjusted EBITDA growth of 5.9%. Like-for-like sales increased 2.4% (3.0% excluding July). The company explicitly states it remains confident in delivering full year 2027 revenue, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPS 'in line with market expectations', which is a clear statement of meeting but not exceeding expectations. No guidance upgrade or change is indicated.

results.headline: Q1 Operating Results & Dividend Declaration
results.key_quote: The two recovery operations achieved a strong combined operating profit for the quarter of £4,152,000 (FY Q1 2026 - £2,086,000)
results.summary: Goldplat reported Q1 operating results that were materially ahead of prior year performance, with combined operating profit nearly doubling from £2.1m to £4.2m year-on-year. The company described operational performance as 'good' and 'strong', with both the South African and Ghanaian operations exceeding prior year profitability. The company declared a dividend and indicated continuing quarterly distributions. No explicit forward guidance or analyst expectations were stated for comparison, but the significant year-on-year improvement and positive operational commentary ('delivered to plan', 'productive quarter', 'good volumes') support an ahead classification.
metrics_ahead: Combined operating profit up 99% YoY to £4,152,000
South African operation profit up 152% YoY to £3,139,000
Combined profit before tax (excl. listing/HO costs) up 76% YoY to £4,184,000
Operations delivering to plan with continuous material supply

results.headline: First Quarter Results
results.key_quote: The portfolio valuation increased by 10.4% during the Period to £668.6m. The increase reflected net acquisitions of £43.6m and net unrealised fair value increases of £30.7m, driven by Xona Space Systems, ICEYE, and Skylo.
results.summary: SSIT reported Q1 results with NAV increasing 4.2% to £734.2m and portfolio valuation up 10.4% to £668.6m, driven by fair value gains and new investments. However, the announcement contains no comparison to market expectations, board guidance, or analyst forecasts. Results are reported on an absolute basis without any forward-looking guidance or expectations context.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: Operating Cash Flow Per Share (OCFPS), our primary long-term measure, increased 59% to 0.74p (H1 FY26: 0.46p), while adjusted EBITDA grew 57% to £3.6m.
results.summary: Software Circle delivered materially ahead of expectations across multiple metrics. OCFPS grew 59%, aEBITDA increased 57% to £3.6m with margin expansion to 29%, revenue grew 23% to £12.6m with recurring revenue up 30%, and oEBITDA increased 47%. The company achieved 7% organic growth and 21% organic oEBITDA growth. Post-period acquisition of eleventh company (Gintech/MidexPRO) with annualised revenues ~£26m at >30% aEBITDA margin demonstrates continued execution. Strong operational progress with AI agents live in products and customer deployments. These results represent significant outperformance across the board with no guidance reduction mentioned.

results.headline: Unaudited results for 6 months ended 30 Sep 2026
results.key_quote: Overall, we remain on track to meet our Adjusted operating profit guidance for CY 2026 of £215m–£230m.
results.summary: Mobico reported adjusted operating profit up 37.7% to £137.4m for the 6 months ended 30 September 2026, driven by outperformance from Alsa and German Rail contract recognition. The company explicitly states it is 'on track to deliver' its full-year 2026 adjusted operating profit guidance of £215m-£230m, indicating results are in line with expectations rather than ahead of or below them. While some metrics show strong growth, the company acknowledges ongoing challenges in WeDriveU and UK Coach, and notes the financial position remains challenging ahead of 2027 maturities.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: Six months into FY27, those foundations are stronger and we are beginning to see encouraging evidence of renewed commercial momentum.
results.summary: Crimson Tide reported H1 FY27 results with revenue decline year-on-year (£2.38m vs £2.95m) due to the previously announced conclusion of a large retail contract. However, the company is on track with expectations: MRR stabilized at £396k, gross revenue churn improved significantly to 3.2% (from 8.8%), net revenue retention at 98.0% puts the company on track for its strongest three-year performance, and positive operating cash flow was maintained. Eight new customers were signed with improved pipeline quality. The results appear in line with management's stated trajectory and previously disclosed expectations rather than materially beating them.
metrics_ahead: Net revenue retention at 98.0% tracking to three-year high
New customer wins and expansion offsetting churn
Pipeline quality improvement with 87 opportunities at £237k potential MRR

results.headline: Unaudited Half Year Results
results.key_quote: while mindful of the challenging consumer environment, the Board's expectations for the full year remain unchanged
results.summary: Cake Box Holdings delivered a resilient H1 performance with revenue flat (0.2% growth) and underlying EBITDA broadly flat year-on-year. Despite challenging trading conditions and record hot weather impacting like-for-like sales, the company achieved improved gross profit margins (5.1% increase), strong free cash flow growth (54.6%), and digital expansion. Management notes improved trading at the start of H2 with record Diwali sales, but crucially states that full-year expectations remain unchanged, indicating results are tracking in line with board expectations rather than ahead of them. The 5.6% interim dividend increase reflects confidence but not outperformance.

results.headline: Trading Statement
results.key_quote: the Group's 2026 performance will be significantly below current market expectations
results.summary: Henry Boot has explicitly stated that 2026 performance will be significantly below current market expectations. The company expects an underlying loss before tax of £0m to £10m (excluding exceptional items), compared to market consensus of £9.4m profit. Key headwinds include weak consumer/business confidence, deferred land and property sales, operational issues at Stonebridge Homes, and a negative fair value movement of around £15m at HBD. Exceptional items are expected to impact reported profit by £40m-£45m. The company has suspended its final dividend and acknowledged disappointing performance.

results.headline: RESULTS OF FUNDRAISE OF £7 MILLION
results.key_quote: The Fundraise generated strong demand, and as a result raised a total of £7,000,000
results.summary: Mkango announced the successful completion of a £7 million fundraise with 25 million new shares placed at 28 pence per share. The announcement states the fundraise 'generated strong demand' but provides no comparison to market expectations, guidance targets, or analyst forecasts regarding the fundraise size, pricing, or company performance metrics. This is a capital raising announcement with no stated performance versus expectations.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: Given this continued momentum, the Directors expect second-half results to exceed first-half performance, as certain one-off costs that affected the first half are not expected to recur.
results.summary: Cooks Coffee delivered ahead of expectations with group total income up 23% to NZ$7.07m, group trading EBITDA up 60% to NZ$0.546m, and a move into net profit (NZ$0.055m) versus a prior loss. Store sales growth of 14.3% significantly outpaced the UK branded café industry growth rate of 5.5% (more than three times faster), and management expects second-half results to exceed first-half performance. Directors express confidence in business models and momentum has continued post-period with 16% UK and Ireland sales growth in the seven weeks to 15 November 2026.
metrics_ahead: Return to group profitability (NZ$0.055m vs NZ$-0.151m loss prior year)
UK growth rate >3x industry growth rate
Ireland growth rate >3x industry growth rate
Post-period store sales growth +16% (seven weeks to 15 Nov 2026)

results.summary: Cardiogeni provided an update on the delayed publication of audited annual accounts for the year ended 31 March 2026. The announcement contains no performance metrics, no comparison to expectations, and no guidance. It is purely an administrative update indicating that audit sign-off is in final stages with expected publication by 4 December 2026, and that trading suspension will remain until accounts are published.

results.headline: Results for the period ended 30 September 2026
results.key_quote: We have made a strong start to FY27, delivering growth in earnings and dividends, a fourth consecutive half-year of valuation growth and further positive momentum in rental performance.
results.summary: NewRiver REIT delivered results ahead of expectations with multiple positive metrics: UFFO per share increased 12% to 3.7p, EPRA NTA per share increased to 106p, and like-for-like portfolio valuation increased 1.4% (the strongest result in the last nine half-year periods). Rental performance was particularly strong with leasing transactions completing 5.1% ahead of ERV, retail occupancy increased to 95.4%, and rolling three-year rental CAGR increased for the fourth consecutive reporting period to 2.4%. The company achieved valuation growth despite equivalent yields moving out by 15 basis points, demonstrating underlying operational strength. Capital allocation was disciplined with accretive acquisitions completed in high-conviction areas.
metrics_ahead: EPRA NTA per share increased to 106p from 105p
Like-for-like portfolio valuation up 1.4% (strongest in nine half-years)
Leasing transactions 32.4% ahead of previous passing rent
Rolling three-year rental CAGR increased to 2.4% for fourth consecutive period

results.headline: Final Results
results.key_quote: Reported revenue and Adjusted EBITDA is in line with the Company's Full Year Trading Update announcement of 19 August 2026
results.summary: Nanoco reported FY26 results with revenue of £10.4m (up 49% YoY) and Adjusted EBITDA of £5.3m. The company explicitly states that reported revenue and Adjusted EBITDA are 'in line with' the Full Year Trading Update of 19 August 2026. While the company achieved encouraging commercial progress with customers, reduced costs, and positive IP settlements, the results match prior guidance rather than exceed it. The company maintains its outlook of achieving break-even in approximately two years.

results.headline: Corporate Update and Judgment in US Litigation
results.key_quote: The Company is in advanced discussions regarding the addition of a number of businesses to the Group which, if concluded, would constitute a reverse takeover... There can be no certainty that the discussions will lead to a transaction, or as to its terms or timing.
results.summary: TSP Advanced Technologies announced a corporate update covering proposed transaction discussions, funding conversations with investors, and adverse judgment in US litigation. The announcement contains no performance metrics, financial results, or guidance compared to expectations. The company is pursuing a reverse takeover and convertible loan funding, but explicitly states there is no certainty these will materialise. A US court judgment of approximately £204,000 was entered against the company regarding a 2022 funding agreement with Spartan Medical, with the court finding the company made knowingly false representations about FDA submission status.

results.headline: Results for the year ended 30 September 2026
results.key_quote: Although there have been many positive developments in the last 12 months, this has undoubtedly been a challenging Period for Impax.
results.summary: Impax reported significant declines across key metrics in FY 2026. AUM fell from £26.1bn to £20.0bn, revenue declined from £141.9m to £113.1m, and adjusted operating profit fell sharply from £33.6m to £16.6m. Net outflows persisted at £7.8bn. While management highlighted improved investment performance since January 2026 and positive strategic developments, actual reported results were materially weaker than the prior year. The company reduced its dividend from 12.0p to 6.7p. No explicit statement compares results to analyst or market expectations, but the significant contraction in revenue, AUM, and profitability indicates underperformance relative to typical expectations for an asset manager. The acknowledgment that this was 'undoubtedly a challenging Period' reinforces the below-expectations assessment.

results.headline: Pets at Home Group plc FY27 Interim Results
results.key_quote: Our improved performance in the first half builds confidence in our compelling proposition. We are operating more consistently and our focus on delivering for customers has driven sales momentum, increased customer satisfaction and market share gains.
results.summary: Pets at Home delivered materially ahead of expectations with significant operational improvements across the business. Group underlying PBT grew 44.2% to £52.2m with margin expansion of 180bps to 6.5%. Retail PBT surged from £3.5m to £16.0m (up from negligible levels), Vets PBT grew 8.6% with 350bps margin improvement to 49.1%, and market share gains were achieved in Retail. Free cash flow improved 63.8% to £55.7m. The company explicitly stated improved momentum drives confidence in refreshed full-year outlook.
metrics_ahead: Store sales returned to growth in Q2
Volume growth comfortably ahead of sales growth

results.headline: GSK announces positive Phase III Exdensur results
results.key_quote: The trial met its primary endpoint, showing depemokimab was non-inferior to mepolizumab in terms of achieving disease remission
results.summary: GSK announced positive Phase III results for Exdensur (depemokimab) in EGPA, meeting the primary endpoint of non-inferiority to mepolizumab. The drug demonstrated comparable efficacy and safety with twice-yearly dosing versus monthly mepolizumab. While results are positive for the program, the announcement describes achievement of the primary endpoint and non-inferiority status, which represents meeting expectations for a Phase III trial rather than materially exceeding them. No explicit statement indicates results beat forecasts, exceeded expectations, or were ahead of guidance.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident in delivering full-year performance in line with market expectations.
results.summary: VP PLC reported H1 FY27 results with revenue down 8.6% and adjusted profit down 2.3% year-on-year. While the company highlighted positive momentum in infrastructure markets and successful restructuring actions, the CEO explicitly stated the Group remains confident in delivering full-year performance 'in line with market expectations.' The company expects H2 FY27 to outperform H2 FY26, but this represents sequential improvement rather than beating overall expectations. No guidance upgrade was announced.
metrics_ahead: Brandon Hire Station returned to profit in Q2

results.headline: Final Results
results.key_quote: This year was challenging for airlines due to the Middle East conflict and its effect on demand and fuel prices, which materially impacted our financial performance.
results.summary: easyJet reported FY26 results materially impacted by the Middle East conflict. Headline profit before tax declined significantly from £665m to £71m, with reported profit falling from £658m to £24m. While the company achieved operational progress (90% load factor, +3% passenger growth, record customer satisfaction), financial performance was substantially below prior year due to elevated fuel costs and demand weakness. The company provided limited FY27 guidance due to the pending acquisition, though noted sequential RASK improvements expected and ex-fuel CASK improvement potential. No explicit statement that results beat or met analyst expectations; instead, results are presented as impacted by external headwinds relative to prior year performance.
metrics_ahead: Customer satisfaction at record levels (82% airline CSAT, 84% holidays CSAT)

results.headline: Update on Thaba Joint Venture
results.key_quote: chrome production guidance has been revised to 75,000 to 85,000 tons from 110,000 to 140,000 tons of chrome concentrate
results.summary: Sylvania Platinum has terminated its Thaba Joint Venture with LMC due to consistent mining underperformance, lower-than-planned ROM ore tonnages, lower feed grades, and significantly higher mining costs. While PGM production guidance remains unchanged, chrome production guidance has been materially lowered from 110,000-140,000 tons to 75,000-85,000 tons of chrome concentrate for FY2027. The company is writing down approximately $51.1 million in outstanding loans to LMC. This represents a significant downgrade in production expectations and negative financial impact.
